import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))

# Color palette for species
colors = {'setosa': '#FF6B6B', 'versicolor': '#4ECDC4', 'virginica': '#45B7D1'}

# 1. Pairplot-style scatter: Petal Length vs Petal Width
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    species_data = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax1.scatter(species_data['petal_length'], species_data['petal_width'], 
                label=species, alpha=0.7, s=80, color=colors[species], edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Petal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.legend(title='Species', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Sepal Length vs Sepal Width
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    species_data = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax2.scatter(species_data['sepal_length'], species_data['sepal_width'], 
                label=species, alpha=0.7, s=80, color=colors[species], edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax2.set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Sepal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.legend(title='Species', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Box plot comparison of all measurements
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
data_melted = df.melt(id_vars=['species'], value_vars=['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width'],
                      var_name='Measurement', value_name='Value (cm)')
sns.boxplot(data=data_melted, x='Measurement', y='Value (cm)', hue='species', ax=ax3, palette=colors)
ax3.set_xlabel('Measurement Type', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Value (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Distribution of Measurements by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.set_xticklabels(['Sepal\nLength', 'Sepal\nWidth', 'Petal\nLength', 'Petal\nWidth'], fontsize=9)
ax3.legend(title='Species', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9, loc='upper left')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--', axis='y')

# 4. Violin plot for petal length distribution
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
parts = ax4.violinplot([df[df['species'] == species]['petal_length'].values for species in df['species'].unique()],
                       positions=[1, 2, 3], widths=0.7, showmeans=True, showmedians=True)
for i, pc in enumerate(parts['bodies']):
    species = list(df['species'].unique())[i]
    pc.set_facecolor(colors[species])
    pc.set_alpha(0.7)
ax4.set_xticks([1, 2, 3])
ax4.set_xticklabels(df['species'].unique(), fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Petal Length Distribution by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--', axis='y')

# Overall title
fig.suptitle('Iris Dataset: Comprehensive Analysis of Flower Measurements', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.99])

# Save figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
